review_method: Read each linked page, compared its concepts with existing notes and the revised local AQA specification. Retained existing worked examples, tables and diagrams. Additions use original wording and examples.

coverage_decisions.decision: Existing types, named values, operator tables, nested control, input and examples retained. Expanded cards on endpoint, branch and post-condition differences.
Added structure versus persistence and array-of-record reasoning. Did not import claims that records are inherently permanent or every language starts indexing at zero.

Added a documented interface, parameter-order example, comment quality and shared dependencies. Retained direct use of return values; source claim that returns must be assigned is incorrect. Global-state problems are explained through coupling, not a blanket memory-saving claim.

checks.browser_review: Passed all topic reading groups and expanded deck at 1366, 390 and 320 pixels. Checked print visibility, hidden sources, focus, keyboard controls, long prose and code answers.
